name: D.C.5 ~Da Capo 5~ Future Link
original_name: D.C.5 Future Link ～ダ・カーポ5～ フューチャーリンク
source:
Fandisk of Da Capo 5.

As spring blooms, continuation of the heroine stories unfolds, linking past into the yearned future.
